# BeatGig — account brief

## Who
BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). The GitHub org profile lists beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in beatgig/beatgig-mobile ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- package.json pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- beatgig-mobile last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile))
- The org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig))
- The iOS app has 1,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))
- 2 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), top contributor to beatgig/beatgig-mobile with 88 commits; profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), top contributor to beatgig/beatgig-mobile with 19 commits; profile lists company "BeatGig" and website https://beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2))

## Why now
The mobile repo was last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)) and two App Store releases went out in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). The app runs on react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, you have 88 commits on beatgig-mobile, the most of anyone on the repo ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). The repo has an eas.json ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)) and the app shipped two App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you cut those two releases, what did the path from commit to submitted build look like on your side?
